**✅ What's strong**
This squad is built on rock-solid foundations. Captain Haaland (4.88 xP) is the obvious skipper — nailed, 0.86 xGI/90 and first on pens. The defensive spine is where the real value sits: Senesi (4.81), Tarkowski (4.72), Virgil, Guéhi and Gabriel all offer strong clean-sheet odds plus elite DEFCON volume racking up +2 most weeks. Anderson (4.62) brings that same DEFCON reliability in midfield. No fitness doubts flagged anywhere — clean bill of health across the board.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building from scratch, so prioritise the pillars: Haaland up top, then double down on high-volume defenders Senesi and Tarkowski at just £6.0m each. Thiago (£8.0m, 0.61 xGI/90, pens #1) is the smart second striker. For value, target differentials Thiaw (£5.0m, 4.2 xP) and Garner (£6.0m, FK #1 plus DEFCON) to free up cash for the premium spine.

**Bottom line:** Nail Haaland's captaincy, stack DEFCON defenders, and this 5-4-1 projects a tidy 53.11-point XI haul.
